plugins.name: goal-mode
plugins.description: Claude가 스스로 세션 goal을 걸고, 독립 evaluator(sonnet)가 Stop마다 충족 여부를 판정해 미충족이면 계속 작업시킨다. 네이티브 ProposeGoal이 있으면 그쪽을 쓴다.

plugins.name: harness
plugins.description: Integrated harness: enforces the user's Claude rules at the tool call (git/worktree/delete/venv/port/Linear/memory guards, merge-and-release gate, report lint), plus session tooling and workflow automation.

plugins.name: model-tier
plugins.description: Routes each main-loop turn to opus, sonnet or haiku by task complexity, with a set_tier tool the model can call to correct itself

plugins.name: auto-claude
plugins.description: Unattended run of a repository: Claude plans the long-term end state and milestones, goal-mode's loop builds each, auto-claude pushes, opens PRs and merges when CI is green, then replans until the final check passes.
